scope: Active trip execution state lifecycle and persistence

contracts.single_active_trip: At most one trip progress record can have isActive == true at any time
contracts.activation_rule: Starting a trip deactivates any previously active trip in an atomic transaction
contracts.manual_milestone_progression: Only explicit traveler clicks on Mark Visited or Skip Stop advance milestones
contracts.tracking_invariants: Zero background location services, zero GPS geofencing, zero simulated telematics

lifecycle_states.start_trip: Sets isActive = true, activeDay = 1, currentMilestoneIndex = 0, startedAt = now, completionState = IN_PROGRESS
lifecycle_states.mark_visited: Appends canonicalPlaceId to completedStopIdsJson, removes from skippedStopIdsJson, increments milestone index
lifecycle_states.skip_stop: Appends canonicalPlaceId to skippedStopIdsJson, removes from completedStopIdsJson, increments milestone index
lifecycle_states.end_trip: Sets isActive = false, completionState = COMPLETED, updates lastUpdatedAt
lifecycle_states.cancel_trip: Sets isActive = false, completionState = CANCELLED, updates lastUpdatedAt

restart_survival: Active progress reloads immediately upon application launch from SQLite / SwiftData disk store
